answer: Progressive tenure multipliers resist sybils: an identity's reward and vote weight are multiplied by a factor that climbs with consecutive epochs of honest participation, from a hollow near-zero at birth toward full only after a long voyage. A swarm minted today sits at the bottom multiplier and cannot buy its way up — the sonnet of tenure must be earned line by line. An attacker gains real influence only by maintaining each fake honestly for many epochs, converting mass creation into a slow, costly, exposed commitment.
